news.title: Needed: Food, Energy, and Water Security
news.summary_en: Dave Cappelleri's work in IoT4Ag, an NSF Engineering Research Center, is putting autonomous ag-robots and physical AI to work on the grand challenge of feeding a growing planet.

news.title: Lombardo named EPICS at Purdue director
news.summary_en: After 20 years of experience in community-engaged learning, Chris Lombardo will start as the new director of EPICS at Purdue University on July 1, 2026.
